guide:0:0:0.text: A team for longer fights, built from Burn-applying Identities that attack while collectively increasing enemy Burn. Variants include physical Burn, Burn and Tremor with Dawn Office and Thumb units, and Dark Flame, which amplifies Burn damage through Magic Bullet Outis.

guide:1:0:0.text: Many priority picks gain Coin Power or Power based on the target's Burn. Building Burn raises the whole team's damage.

guide:1:0:1.text: Many requirements are modest, such as at least 6 Burn or +1 per 6 Burn, up to +2. This suggests that even a small number of Burn users can support the core pattern.

guide:1:0:2.text: [Firefist Office Survivor](persona:1211) is the anchor. Every skill from S1 to S3 adds Burn Count, almost sustaining Burn alone. His passive, which increases another enemy's Burn Count after killing or Staggering a Burning enemy during Wrath Resonance, is supplementary.

guide:2:0:0.text: Start by building Burn on enemies with Burn-applying skills.

guide:2:0:1.text: Burn stops when Count runs out. Sustain it with Firefist Office Survivor's skills and benched [Liu Assoc. South Section 5](persona:0604): at Uptie Ⅲ with 4 Wrath Owned, he adds 1 to the Burn Count applied by the ally with the highest SP. [Liu Assoc. South Section 3](persona:0112)'s S3 reduces Burn Count by 2, so avoid it when Count is low.

guide:2:0:2.text: Firefist Office Survivor and Liu Assoc. South Section 3 have Wrath S2s, and 4 members have Wrath S3s, making Wrath resources easy to accumulate. This supports Wrath E.G.O such as Rodion's [4th Match Flame](ego:0902).

guide:2:0:3.text: Cover healing through E.G.O such as [Into the Sunset](ego:0909) and [Indicant's Trial](ego:0908), available when deploying The House of Spiders: The Thumb Nursefather Rodion.

guide:3:heading.text: Adding Dawn Office, Thumb, or You Branch units

guide:3:0:0.text: These coordinated packages can replace priority picks. Choose according to the units you own.

guide:3:0:1.text: The Dawn Office package assumes all 3 together: [Dawn Office Fixer Sinclair](persona:1009), [Dawn Office Fixer Faust](persona:0216), and [Dawn Office Rep](persona:1216). Their coordination triggers follow-ups and supplies Gloom and Envy resources. Raw damage exceeds the Firefist option, but all are Walpurgisnacht-exclusive.

guide:3:0:2.text: The Thumb package pairs [The House of Spiders: The Thumb Nursefather](persona:0916) with [The House of Spiders: The Thumb Apprentice](persona:0716). While the Nursefather has The Eye of Precognition, a hit from the Apprentice's Base Skill triggers his own La Spada di Palermo follow-up once per turn. The Apprentice shares a Sinner with [Heishou Pack - You Branch Adept](persona:0714), so choose one.

guide:3:0:3.text: The You Branch package uses [The Lord of Hongyuan](persona:0613) to swap Heishou units. They are fragile, so take care not to lose clashes.

guide:3:0:4.text: Combining both Dawn Office and Thumb units shifts the team toward Tremor - Scorch. Both Burn Count and Tremor Count need attention.

guide:4:0:0.text: Dark Flame applied by Outis's [Magic Bullet](persona:1107) Identity and [Magic Bullet](ego:1108) E.G.O deals Pride damage equal to Dark Flame × the target's Burn at Turn End. More Burn means more damage; its Pride affinity also works against Wrath-resistant enemies.

guide:4:0:1.text: Reach at least 3 Magic Bullets, use the Magic Bullet E.G.O alongside at least 4 Resonance, then use S3 at 7 Magic Bullets to reset to 0. Repeat.

guide:4:0:2.text: Magic Bullet Outis's S3 consumes substantial SP and has a 50% chance to hit allies at 10 SP or less. Support her SP with benched [Liu Assoc. South Section 3](persona:0112), and omit the You Branch or Dawn Office Identities that inflict Burn on themselves.

guide:4:0:3.text: Best against a single boss. Slow to get going and poor against ordinary groups.

guide:5:0:0.text: Wrath is the most common affinity among the priority picks, with 8 of their 30 Base Skills, so Wrath-resistant enemies are somewhat troublesome. The Dark Flame variant can use Pride damage instead.

guide:5:0:1.text: The enhancement conditions are modest, so open slots can also take strong general-purpose Identities without Burn. If a priority pick is missing, check the flexible and alternative slots below.

metadata.description: Limbus Company Burn team guide: Burn-applying Identities that grow enemy Burn together for long fights. Covers the physical Burn, Burn and Tremor (Dawn Office and Thumb), and Dark Flame (Magic Bullet Outis) variants, with priority, flexible, and bench roles.

note: English translation of the existing public team guide and lineup notes; preserves the Japanese recommendations.
